name: dispatch
description: Plan before you fly — interview-driven specs you can execute. preflight captures what you want as INTENT.md before any solution is chosen; hop interviews, plans, and executes a small scope in one session; flightplan writes a multi-file blueprint to disk; autopilot flies the tree with a dev→verify→judge→score quality loop; waypoints orchestrates the rolling-wave roadmap tier above flightplan; deckplan is a reference-only guide to authoring Workflow scripts for flightdeck.

interface.shortDescription: Interview-driven planning, from captured intent to in-conversation specs to multi-file blueprints for sub-agents.
interface.longDescription: Six skills in one plugin, forming a ladder. preflight is the first rung: a short interview that captures what you want as docs/<slug>/INTENT.md before anyone decides how to build it — it refuses to answer 'how', writes one file, and stops, so the eventual plan has a frozen baseline to be checked against. hop is the everyday rung: it interviews through structured questions, writes a single in-conversation plan to approve, and then executes it in the same session. flightplan is the heavyweight sibling: it interviews thoroughly, then commits a complete blueprint to disk — PLAN.md plus a tasks/ tree with shared _context/ files and self-contained task files a different session or sub-agent can pick up and execute independently; it reads an existing INTENT.md as its baseline. autopilot executes that tree: for each ready task it runs a dev→verify→judge→score loop that gates on the task's own Eval rubric, retrying until it passes, then runs the closing final-review task as the whole-tree gate — leaving an audit trail of every verdict. waypoints orchestrates the rolling-wave milestone-roadmap tier above flightplan. deckplan explains how to author Workflow scripts for flightdeck; it runs no interview, scaffolds nothing, generates no artifacts, and bundles no scripts.
defaultPrompt: Write down what I want here — don't decide how yet.
Interview me to spec this out before we build.
Help me think through this idea.
Fully spec this out and break it into task files.
Draft a PLAN.md and tasks for sub-agents.
Execute the flightplan in docs/<slug> with autopilot.
Explain how to author a Workflow script I can watch on flightdeck.
